description: This Java source file defines the ShuffleSecretManager class, which manages shuffle secrets for applications in Apache Spark's external shuffle service. It handles registration, unregistration, and retrieval of secrets and provides the SASL user for authentication.

classes.name: ShuffleSecretManager
classes.description: Manages shuffle secrets for applications, allowing registration, unregistration, and secret retrieval, and provides the SASL user for authentication.

methods.name: ShuffleSecretManager
methods.description: Constructor initializing the shuffle secret map.

methods.name: registerApp
methods.description: Registers an application with its secret, either as a String or ByteBuffer.

methods.name: unregisterApp
methods.description: Unregisters an application and its secret.

methods.name: getSaslUser
methods.description: Returns the SASL user for authentication.

methods.name: getSecretKey
methods.description: Retrieves the secret key for a given application ID.
